calendarYearHint: Set a Gregorian year as BC or AD. Each turn advances one year.
populationHint: Initial actors (2–100). Births can raise the count up to 100 when wealth and happiness are high.
seedHint: RNG seed. Same value reproduces terrain, positions, traits, and ties.
taxRateHint: Higher burden favors obedience costs and resistance (0–1).
educationHint: Higher cooperation success and resource growth (0–1).
resourcePoolHint: Slack in hunting, gathering, and farming. Scarcity favors grabbing; plenty favors sharing.
theaterHint: The continental theater. Groups are snapped onto land.
geographyHint: The continental theater. Groups are snapped onto land.

conditionGroups.natureLead: Together with climate, this sets how much food and shared resource slack there is.
conditionGroups.disasterLead: How often typhoons, quakes, floods, heat waves, or cold snaps hit. The mix follows landform and climate.
conditionGroups.societyLead: Population, institutions, tax, education, and how readily people obey.
conditionGroups.religionLead: Shapes deference to authority and how often resistance appears.

religionHint: Organized faith favors obedience; secular outlooks make resistance easier.
ambitionHint: Higher leadership contests and political rivalry (0–1).
inequalityHint: Higher spread of wealth at t=0 (0–1).
landformHint: Continents have more interior; island chains favor coasts and fragmentation. This shapes the sim grid.
climateHint: Tints the theater and changes movement cost and resource growth. Not a full weather model.
institutionHint: Affects how readily people obey or resist.

wizard.lead1: Geography, nature, and food are preset. Read inland, coast, and islands in the table, then pick a start year.
wizard.lead2: Change social constraints per continent to see whether futures diverge in one world.
wizard.lead3: Set religion and disposition per continent to compare group-agent character.

africa.inland: Sahara to plateau. Dry; farming and travel are hard.
africa.coast: Mediterranean and Guinea coasts. Gateways for trade.
africa.island: Madagascar and nearby isles. Easy to split from the mainland.
africa.climate: Mostly arid. Heat waves are common.
africa.food: Scarce, clustered in coasts and valleys.
africa.disaster: Heat and quakes often cut food slack.

europe.inland: Broad plains. People can gather even inland.
europe.coast: North Sea and Atlantic. Ports and fishing are strong.
europe.island: Britain and others. Sea crossings split institutions.
europe.climate: Temperate. Winters bite, extremes are rarer.
europe.food: Slack is high. Grain and pasture mix well.

asia.inland: Plateaus and steppe. Dry and cold inland.
asia.coast: Monsoon coasts. People and rice concentrate here.
asia.island: Japan and others. Crossing is possible, splits remain.
asia.food: Rivers and wetlands feed many, but water can fail them.

america.inland: Great plains. Room to spread, but distances are long.
america.coast: Two oceans. Ports and fisheries split east and west.
america.island: Caribbean and others. Far from the mainland, storm-prone.
america.climate: Mostly temperate, with a north–south spread.
america.disaster: Moderate mix of quakes and storms.

oceania.inland: Little true interior. Almost no continental depth.
oceania.coast: Nearly all coastal. Fishing and sea lanes dominate.
oceania.island: The body is an archipelago. Neighbors sit across water.
oceania.food: Uneven by island. Slack is smaller.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.inequalityHint: Wealth spread (stddev ÷ mean). Higher = wider gap.
metrics.trustHint: Mean pairwise trust (−1 to 1). Higher favors cooperation.
metrics.cooperationRateHint: Share of successful cooperate actions last turn (0–1).

map.title: World map
map.legend: Color fill = group territory. Labels scale from band to city to nation. Red dashes = clashes. Dot color matches the group.
map.zoomHintFlat: Drag to pan. Scroll or double-click to zoom.
Drag to pan. Scroll or double-click to zoom.
map.zoomHintGlobe: Drag to orbit. Scroll or double-click to zoom.

events.title: Events
events.empty: No events yet. Create a simulation and advance turns.

eventDetails.wait_low_energy: Too tired, so rested to recover.
eventDetails.cooperate_missing_target: No partner found, so they waited.
eventDetails.cooperate_success: Cooperated with {target} and both gained wealth.
eventDetails.conflict_missing_target: No opponent found, so no fight happened.
eventDetails.conflict_win: Won a fight against {target} and took {stolen} wealth.
eventDetails.conflict_lose: Lost a fight against {target} and lost {stolen} wealth.
eventDetails.obey: Obeyed the institution and paid {tax} in tax.
eventDetails.resist: Resisted the institution and lowered its authority.
eventDetails.birth: {child} was born, and the population grew.
eventDetails.birth_charisma: {child} was born with a charismatic presence.
eventDetails.birth_genius: {child} was born with signs of genius.
eventDetails.birth_both: {child} was born with both charisma and genius.
eventDetails.group_quiet: No group made a major move.
eventDetails.group_obey: {group} obeyed the institution and paid tax.
eventDetails.disaster_typhoon: A typhoon struck and coastal groups were hurt.
eventDetails.disaster_earthquake: An earthquake shook wealth and security.
eventDetails.disaster_flood: Floods washed away fields and stores.
eventDetails.disaster_heatwave: A heat wave drained energy and food.
eventDetails.disaster_frost: A cold snap cut the harvest and stores.
